compute_te_drift: compute the total energy drift from an NVE molecular dynamics trajectory file
calculate_moving_average: calculate a moving average of a numpy array with a configurable window size
join_nvemd_results: join NVE MD drift results from multiple trajectory files into a single list
compute_nvemd_metrics: compute the mean drift in meV per atom per second from NVE MD results
save_nvemd_metrics: save NVE MD benchmark metrics to a JSON file in the results directory
